framework: VanMoof LPC-trio vm CAN/OD + M_CAN, VMFW

functions.name: temp_adc_isr
functions.role: ADC0 IRQ22: NTC sample -> deg C (index-40, 127 = out of range) -> g_temp_cb

functions.name: od_send_if_active
functions.role: publish data on an OD record if mode==2

functions.name: wheel_timeout_cb
functions.role: CTIMER0 timeout: reset, MR0=249999, disarm, publish speed {0,2500}

functions.name: sys_image_validate
functions.role: VMFW header check, anti-rollback floor 1.8.8 (also sys_image_size)

functions.name: odometer_load
functions.role: read ring page, check 'VMKYS\0' magic, return u32 @+8

functions.name: odometer_save
functions.role: write count to next ring page, erase old

functions.name: wheel_pulse_cb
functions.role: CTIMER0 pulse: speed/period (010001a1), distance every 30 pulses (010002a1), save every 6000

functions.name: config_store_write
functions.role: RMW of 512-B config page; lock byte +0x3e -> -22

functions.name: od_ota_begin
functions.role: OD 01008200: erase pages, set write window

functions.name: main
functions.role: clock/peripheral init, node 0xa1, sensor init, superloop (vendor init mostly; not yet C)

functions.name: can_frame_encode
functions.role: shared LPC-trio vm CAN/OD TX (frontlight can_od.c)

functions.name: od_write_lock
functions.role: OD 01009400 write: lock byte + production lock

functions.name: sys_image_clear_marker
functions.role: erase slot last page unless blank

od_table.record: {od_id, mode(0 read/1 write/2 notify), len, timeout, retries, handler|1}
